points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, metadata, props?, toModel })` declares the block. `flavour` is the type id, written `affine:<name>`... `metadata` holds `version`, `role`
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (`'content'`, `'hub'` or `'root'`) and the allowed `children` and `parent` flavours.
`class XBlockModel extends BlockModel<Props>` is the data class... `toModel` returns `new DividerBlockModel()`.
It is a Lit element... builds on `BlockComponent`... It calls `this.renderChildren(this.model)`... registers `BlockViewExtension('affine:divider', literal`affine-divider`)`.

`XStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider`... `XViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider`... The editor or app (for example the `affine-shared`/`ext-loader` extension manager) then registers the Store and View providers.
`effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom element.
